providers.name: Asialink Regional Plan
providers.note: The safest default recommendation — broadest coverage and the only major regional plan that reliably includes India.

providers.name: Asia Unlimited
providers.note: Best for heavy data users who don't want to track GB usage — trade-off is restricted hotspot sharing.

providers.name: SEA + Japan/Korea Regional
providers.coverage: Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia circuit
providers.note: Automatically switches carriers as you cross borders — the top pick for multi-country circuits like Japan+Korea or a Thailand-Vietnam-Cambodia loop.

providers.name: Asia Value Plan
providers.note: The budget pick when a traveler just wants the cheapest reliable data, not brand recognition.

providers.name: Global + In-Flight/Cruise
providers.note: The only major provider with in-flight and cruise/maritime connectivity — a genuinely distinct use case worth its own guide.

providers.name: Single-Country Plans
providers.coverage: Single-country focus, cheaper than regional bundles
providers.price: Often 50% less than regional plans for 1-2 country trips
providers.note: Best when a traveler is staying in just one or two countries — regional bundles overpay for coverage they won't use.
